title: Carthage Rises, Rome Plots
hook: Part 8. Carthage’s streets are alive again, but Rome’s envy becomes dread.
full_narration: Part 8. Carthage’s streets are alive again, but Rome’s envy becomes dread. Gold spills through the markets—merchants bargain beneath the old city walls. [[pause:0.4]] Roman traders linger in the shadows, counting coins, watching every ship. Across the sea, word spreads—Carthage grows rich, and Rome feels the chill. [[voice:tense]] In the Senate, old rivals gather, faces hard, voices sharpened by fear. Cato the Elder stands, his fist pounding the marble, demanding Carthage’s destruction. [[pause:0.6]] Some senators hesitate, haunted by memories of Hannibal’s campaign. But fear twists the chamber—Carthage’s strength becomes a shadow on every Roman mind. Carthaginian leaders meet in secret, wary of the storm building across the water. [[voice:low]] Rome’s merchants whisper—Can Carthage be trusted, or will old wars return? The Senate’s debate turns bitter—words become threats, threats become promises. Rome’s leaders search for a reason—any reason—to strike first. The next war is coming. [[pause:0.8]] Follow for part 9.

youtube_description: As Carthage’s markets roar back to life, Rome’s envy curdles into fear. Roman merchants watch uneasily as gold flows and ships return. In the shadows of the Senate, old enemies gather—Cato the Elder demands Carthage’s end, while some senators are haunted by memories of Hannibal. But fear spreads like wildfire. Secret meetings in Carthage, whispered warnings in Roman streets, and bitter debates reveal a world teetering on the edge. Rome’s leaders search desperately for a reason to strike before Carthage can rise again. A new war is coming. Witness the darkness before the storm in Part 8 of The Fall of Carthage. Follow for part 9.
